name: Ripacandida (Italy)
description: Yellow field with a blue border, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Ripacandida (a yellow lion on blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Ripacandida, a comune in Basilicata; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Ripacandida arms — yellow lion on blue, crowned, within branches
